segments.arabic:
١٠٩٢٨- برة بنت أبي سلمة بن عبد الأسد ،
هي زينب ربيبة رسول اللَّه ﷺ كان اسمها برّة فغيّره النبيّ ﷺ لما تزوج أمّها، فسماها زينب. وستأتي ترجمتها في حرف الزاي إن شاء اللَّه تعالى.
(١) الثقات ٣/ ٣٩، السمط الثمين ٢٠٩، تجريد أسماء الصحابة ٢/ ٢٥١، أعلام النساء ١/ ١٠٤.
segments.english:
10928 — Barrah bint Abi Salama ibn Abd al-Asad

She is Zaynab, the stepdaughter of the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Her name was Barrah, but the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—changed it when he married her mother and named her Zaynab. Her entry will appear under the letter zay, if Allah Most High wills.

(1) al-Thiqat, 3/39; al-Simt al-Thamin, 209; al-Tajrid, 2/251; A'lam al-Nisa, 1/104.

unresolved.arabic_span: برّة بنت أبي تجراة بن أبي فكيهة، واسمه يسار ... كان أبوها يسار يكنى أبا فكيهة
unresolved.explanation: The heading makes Abu Tajra'a the son of Abu Fukayha and most naturally associates the name Yasar with Abu Fukayha, whereas Ibn Sa'd's following statement calls Barrah's father Yasar and says that he bore the kunya Abu Fukayha. The collateral works abbreviate the genealogy and do not resolve the discrepancy. Both canonical statements have therefore been preserved without harmonization.
